# awvoice

> Hear and speak — transcribe audio, synthesize a voice.

An agent that can only read text is deaf and mute. Every route to fixing that today is a vendor SDK that wants the audio uploaded, an API key, and a per-minute bill -- which rules it out for exactly the recordings people most want transcribed.

## Install

```
pip install awvoice
```

## In Claude Code

- hook: `awvoice reply` (on Stop)
- skill: `/awvoice`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Turn speech into text and text into speech, on a service you host.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awbrowse](https://aitherium.github.io/awbrowse/) — A portable browser client — navigate, console, network, DOM, screenshot.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.
- [awdesk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdesk/) — Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.
- [awask](https://aitherium.github.io/awask/) — Your agent asks you a question — and acts on your answer.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.
- [awdeck](https://aitherium.github.io/awdeck/) — An outline becomes a narrated video -- and the file says which voice really spoke it.
